name: GIRDER 格拉德 Arrow 2025 105 Di2
why_interesting: A current official mainland aero-road complete with Shimano 105 Di2, T47 threaded bottom bracket, UDH, carbon wheels and a full size chart at a ¥12,800 list price.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 Di2 R7170 2×12; FC-R7100 52-36T 170 mm crank, CS-R7100 11-36T cassette, CN-M7100 chain
facts.frame: 2025 Arrow T800 + T1000 carbon aero frame and fork, 12 mm thru-axles, UDH dropout, fully hidden cable routing
facts.frame_material: T800 + T1000 carbon frame (reinforced bottom-bracket area) and fork; fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded aero frame and fork with fully hidden routing and a separate Shimano Di2 battery storage design
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found; the reinforced bottom-bracket wording is manufacturer construction copy, not a test result
facts.bottom_bracket: T47 threaded, P1.0 thread, 84.5 mm shell width supplied with two 1 mm shims
facts.wheels: Adler Augen Classic unpainted carbon wavy-rim wheels, 50 mm front / 60 mm rear, ceramic-bearing hubs, Sapim spokes
facts.tires: Maxxis 700C×28C folding tires fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: Adler Augen 2025 unpainted aero integrated carbon handlebar with internal routing and 6° offset
facts.geometry: Official chart, stack/reach mm: XS 497/371, S 506/380, M 517/385, L 529/393.6; head angle 70–72°, seat angle 74.5–75°, chainstay 410 mm, BB drop 72 mm, wheelbase 977–993 mm
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for the 105 Di2 complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated
facts.community_model_year_context: A promotional XHS post dated 2025-08-15 calls an R7170 Arrow the 2026 model and states 8.4 kg without a size or pedal basis. Equivalence to this official 2025 T47/UDH generation is unverified; the official 8.44 kg reference remains unchanged.
facts.used_market_context: An XHS listing dated 2025-11-12 asked CNY 7,999 for a used S-size R7170 Arrow with carbon wheels and an integrated bar. Its frame generation is unidentified; this historical asking price is not a current new-bike or exact-trim quote.

missing: Complete-weight size, pedal and measurement basis
Independent exact-model stiffness or deflection measurement
Current mainland marketplace listing or checkout amount, warranty issuer, warranty term and invoice handling

official_price.price_basis: Manufacturer-listed price on the exact NEW 2025 ARROW page; no mainland marketplace listing or checkout amount was observed

source_note: The official NEW 2025 ARROW page publishes the complete 105 Di2 build, T800 + T1000 frame and fork, T47 BB, UDH, 8.44 kg claim, geometry chart and a ¥12,800 price. The official route is a direct sales inquiry; no mainland marketplace listing was verified. This is not the older press-fit T700 + T800 Arrow, which has different sizes, weight and price.
price_status: Official CNY 12,800 list price observed 2026-10-23; no marketplace listing or checkout amount verified
